multi_entity_note: Cooperation agreement between Beike Internet (Beijing) Security Technology Co., Ltd. and Baidu Online Network Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
processing_note: The financial settlement between the parties will be carried out monthly.

contract.document_name.rationale: The heading and preamble name the Cooperation Agreement; 'Exhibit 10.43' is a filing label.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: Only the cover date April 2013 is given without a day; the signature dates are blank.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Article 3.1.1 makes the agreement effective on May 1, 2013, the start of the Cooperation Term.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The Cooperation Term runs to April 30, 2015; April 30, 2013 is the termination date of earlier contracts.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Article 10.1 (and 11.9) subject the agreement to PRC Laws; other PRC mentions are the place of execution or definitions.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: No renewal term is stated; the parties may only negotiate before expiry.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice to prevent renewal is stated; the one-month reference is a negotiation window.
